description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Capgemini is hiring a Software Engineer to support the design and implementation of integration solutions. The role involves clarifying business requirements, contributing to integration specifications, and helping troubleshoot and improve integration solutions with cross-functional teams.
Software Engineer supporting system integration design, API mapping, troubleshooting, security compliance, and performance monitoring

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with Product, Business Analysis, and Application IT teams to gather, analyze, and clarify functional requirements
• Participate in technical discussions related to integration architecture, data flows, and system interfaces
• Analyze and interpret API schemas and integration specifications, including REST, SOAP, and file-based integrations
• Assist in creating technical mapping documents, integration design specifications, and supporting documentation
• Support troubleshooting, triaging, and resolution of integration defects and production issues
• Ensure adherence to integration security standards and best practices
• Contribute to performance testing, monitoring, and observability initiatives
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality integration solutions

Requirements:
• Basic understanding of integration protocols and data formats, including REST APIs, SOAP Services, and File-based Integrations
• Knowledge of integration patterns such as Synchronous, Asynchronous (Event-Driven), and Batch Processing Integrations
• Familiarity with cloud technologies, preferably AWS
• Understanding of security standards and authentication protocols including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Encryption Methodologies
• Experience with, or willingness to learn, testing tools such as Postman and JMeter
• Understanding of monitoring and observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently when required
• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and high-quality technical documentation

Preferred:
• 1–3 years of experience in a Technical Analyst, Integration Analyst, Integration Specialist, or related IT role
• Exposure to enterprise integration projects
• Familiarity with AWS services such as:

+ S3
+ API Gateway
+ MSK (Managed Streaming for Kafka)
+ Redis
• AWS Certification or equivalent cloud experience is preferred
